title: Work tape range across a seam
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be two-tape Turing machines over Boolean symbols, with state sets $S_1$ and $S_2$, respectively, and choose an exit state $e$ of $M_1$ and an entry state $a$ of $M_2$. Suppose configurations $c_0,c_1$ of $M_1$ satisfy that running $M_1$ from $c_0$ for $t_1$ steps gives $c_1$, whose state is $e$, and that no earlier time $u<t_1$ has state $e$. If integer bounds $\ell_j,h_j$ are specified for each of the two work tapes, and the work-tape head positions of the run of $M_1$ from $c_0$ remain in $[\ell_j,h_j]$ through time $t_1$, while those of $M_2$ started from $c_1$ with its state renamed to $a$ remain in those intervals through time $t_2$, then the work-tape head positions of the composite machine run from $c_0$ with its state renamed to the left component remain in the same intervals through time $t_1+1+t_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $S_1,S_2$ are state types and $x$ is a finite Boolean input
An exit state $e$ of $M_1$ and entry state $a$ of $M_2$ are specified
$c_0,c_1$ are configurations of $M_1$ and $t_1,t_2$ are natural numbers
No time $u<t_1$ in the first run has state $e$
For each tape, integer lower and upper bounds are specified
The first run's work-tape head positions stay within the bounds for all times through $t_1$
The second run, started from $c_1$ with state renamed to $a$, stays within the bounds for all times through $t_2$
